content: 'Ixaheritsixi hutarieka kememɨte'itsutɨa meyukwitɨwetɨ
'Ixaheritsixi Yawé mekaniuta'iwawiya, Kutsuhexi 'ukumawereku reutiyetana: ―¿Kemɨ'aneta hikɨ panuyeyerɨni mɨwatakwinikɨ Kananeutsixi?
Yawé mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Kura manuyehaitɨani kanayeimɨkɨ, nekaniyetuirieniri 'ikɨ kwie naime.

Hikɨ Kura xiɨyarimama mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe yu'iwama, Tsimehuni xiɨyarimama: «Hikɨmɨtɨka teyunaitɨ kwie temɨyetuiriyarietsie, Kananeutsixi tepɨwaretakwini, 'ariketa tame xehamatɨa tepuhu kwie xemɨyetuiriyarietsie». Hikɨ Tsimiyuni xiɨyarimama mekaniwareweiya.
Kepauka Kura kananeutsixi meta peretseutsixi mɨwarutakwi, Yawé kaniparewieni. Tamamata miriyari mekaniwarukwini Wetseki mɨrakutewatsie.
Mana mekaniuyukaxeiya 'Aruni-Wetseki matɨa, mɨkɨ mekaniwarutakwini, mekaniwara'iwa kananeutsixi meta peretseutsixi.
'Aruni-Wetseki kaniuyuta'unakaitɨni peru mekanenukuweiya mehenuku'axeka, mekanenuwitekiriexɨani 'itɨwameya 'amɨpapa meta ketateyatsiemieme.

Hikɨ 'Aruni-Wetseki mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Haika tewiyari heimana tamamata te'aitamete yu'itɨwame 'amɨpapa mewatiwitekiyarietɨkaitɨ meta yuketatetsie, nemexatɨa mɨranakaxɨrɨwe mekatenekukwa'akaitɨni. Kakaɨyari yaxeikɨa hikɨ pɨnetsi'uyuri». 'Ana Kerutsareme mekaneihana, manari kanemɨni.
Kura xiɨyarimamatsiere Kerutsaremetari mekaniwarutakwini, 'ixiparakɨ yunaime mekaniwarukwini, meta naime kiekari mekaniutataiya.
'Ariketa Kura xiɨyarimama mekanekɨne hɨritsie kananeutsixi mewatakwinike, Nekexi mɨrakutewatsie meta Tsepera.
Kananeutsixi Hewuruni kiekatari wahetsɨa paitɨ mekaniye'axɨani, Kiriati-'Ariwa mɨtitewakai meripaitɨ, te'aitamete Tsetsahi, 'Akimani, meta Tarimahi mekaniwarukwini.
Mana memɨyekɨ Rewixi kiekariyaritsie meye'axɨaka mekaniwarutakwini, meripaitɨ Kiriati-Tsepexi mɨtitewakai.
Hikɨ Karewi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Kemɨ'ane Kiriati-Tsepexi mɨtamieni maye'ani, ne neniwe nekaniwitɨtɨamɨkɨ 'Akatsa».
'Utunieri katiniuyurieni Kenatsi nu'aya, Karewi taruya, hikɨ Kare yuniwe kaniwitɨtɨani 'Akatsa.
Kepauka mɨkɨ hetsɨana munua, 'Utunieri kanitawawirieni yupapa kwie mɨtawawirienikɨ. 'Akatsa 'anakayaku puxutsie Karewi kanita'iwawiya: ―¿Kekuta pe'ane?

Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Waɨkawa kwerietɨ nepɨmatsiwawirie. Kwie pemɨnetsi'umi Nekexi mieme, haixateta keneneuxatɨa nepiini mayanikɨ. Mɨpaɨ Karewi yuniwe katiniyetuirieni haixate, hɨritsie muxuawekai meta muweritsie.

'Uwaxi nuiwarimama Keni tewiyari, Muitsexi munieya, Kura xiɨyarimama mekaniwareweiya, Makutakɨya memɨyekɨ 'atsita makumawetsie Kura kwieyaritsie, Nekexi mukuma 'Arari kwieyari 'aurie. Mana mekaniuyuhayewa mana kiekatari wahamatɨa.
'Ariketa Kura xiɨyarimama mekaniwareweiya yu'iwama, Tsimehuni xiɨyarimama, mekaniwarutakwini kananeutsixi Tsepati kiekatari, mekanika'una naime kiekari. 'Arike Tsepati, Kuxima katiniuterɨwarieni.
Kura xiɨyarimamata Kahatsa kiekariyaritsie mekanitahaxɨani meta 'Atsikaruni 'Ekuruni, mɨkɨ yuxexuitɨ yukwie meheuxeiyatɨ mekanakɨne mewara'iwaka.
Kura xiɨyarimama wahamatɨa Yawé kaniuyeikakaitɨni. Mɨkɨ hɨriyaritetsie mekaniukuyaxixɨani mewara'iwaka, peru muweritsie kiekatari mepɨkawarukemakaxɨa, tepɨa kaxetayari memɨwareuxeiyakaikɨ.
Muitsexi kemutayɨkai, Karewi Hewuruni tipiinieya kanayani, mana kiekaritsie yuhaikame 'Anaki niwemama kaniwarayeweiya.
Wenikamini xiɨyarimamata kewutseutsixi mewarayeweiyake mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa, Kerutsareme memɨtitekai. 'Ayumieme hikɨ 'akuxi kewutseutsixi Wenikamini xiɨyarimama wahamatɨa mekaniu'uwani.
Kutse xiɨyarimamata Weteri mekaniye'axɨani, Yawé kaniwaparewiekaitɨni.
Nenieremete meri Weteri mekaniwarenɨ'ani, kiekari meripaitɨ 'Arimetɨra makuma mɨrakutewakai,
xewitɨ kiekame 'ayeyaku mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: «Ketatineutaxatɨa ketemɨtehaxɨani kiekaritsie, 'ekɨ 'ana 'aixɨa tepɨmatexeiyani».
Mɨkɨ tewi kaniwaruxeitsitɨani kememɨteheutahaxɨanikekai, hikɨ mɨkɨta mekaniwarukwini 'ixiparakɨ, peru mɨkɨ tewi tɨɨriyamama yunaime mepɨkawarukwi.
Mɨkɨ tewi kaneyani hetitsixi wakwietsie, mana yukiekari kaniukamani katiniterɨwa 'Arimetɨra, hikɨ 'akuxi mɨpaɨ katinakutewaka.

Manatsexi xiɨyarimama mepɨkawarukemakaxɨa Wetsehani kiekatari meta Tanaki kiekari 'auriena mamanetɨka, meta Ruxi kiekariyaritsie, 'Iwurehami meta Mekiru kiekatari mepɨkawarukemakaxɨa meta kiekarite 'auriena mamanetɨka kananeutsixi, memɨkayuwaɨriyakaikɨ memanuku'uni.
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi metɨrɨkawitɨ memakɨ mepuyɨwekaxɨa waɨriyarika mepɨtewaruta'uximayatsitɨa kananeutsixi, tsepa hatsuaku memɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa memɨwarayeweiya yunaime.
'Epɨrahini xiɨyarimama tsiere mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa memɨwarayeweiyakɨ Ketsehexi kiekatari, mɨpaɨ kananeutsixi watsata mekateniuyuhayewa.
Tsawuruni xiɨyarimama yaxeikɨa mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa memɨwarayeweiyakɨ kananeutsixi, Kituruni kiekatari meta Naruri kiekatari, mɨkɨ wahamatɨa mekaniuyuhayewa mete'aitɨarietɨ waɨriyarika.
'Atsexi xiɨyarimamatatsiere mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa memɨwarayeweiyakɨ 'Akuhu kiekatari, Tsiruni, 'Akirawi, 'Akitsiwi, Keriwa, 'Apeki meta Xekuwi.
Memɨka'uyɨwekaxɨakɨri 'Atsexi xiɨyarimama kananeutsixi watsata mekaniuyuhayewa mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie memu'uwakai.

Nepɨtahari xiɨyarimamatatsiere mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa memɨwarayeweiya Weti-Tsemetsi kiekatari meta Weti-'Anati, mɨpaɨ kananeutsixi wahamatɨa mekaniuyuhayewa mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie. Tsikeretsɨ waɨriyarika mekateniwaruta'aitɨani teɨteri Weti-Tsemetsi meta Weti-'Anati kiekatari.
'Amuxeutsixi Rani xiɨyarimama waɨriyarika mekaniwarupitɨani muhɨriyatsie memɨyuhayewanikɨ, mukuweritsie memɨwakakɨnekɨ mepɨkawapitɨakai.

'Amuxeutsixi mepɨyuwaɨriyakai Heretsi hɨriyaritsie memɨtitenikɨ, meta 'Ayaruni, Tsariwini. Peru kepauka Kutse xiɨyarimama meyumɨiretɨ memakɨ, 'amuxeutsixi mekateniuta'aitɨarieni waɨriyarika memɨte'uximayakakɨ.
'Amuxeutsixi wakwie kaniye'atɨkateitɨni tsutɨtɨ, Terɨkaxi mematihe mɨrakutewatsie 'ukuhanetɨ Tsera paitɨ ye'atɨkaitɨ matsi'akuxi heimana paitɨ.
